lines.text: Unlocks: Clear stage 6600105

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: Commander.

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: Do you have a minute?
Sure.

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: Okay, cool.

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: I wanted to tell you something.
What is it?

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: Ever since we met, you're all I've been able to think about. So... and this is all just hypothetical... do you think it would be ever possible for us to... you know... date?
I don't think that would work.
Sure, let's go for it.

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: Commander, do you realize what day it is?
April Fool's Day. Why?

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: I was just pulling your leg asking that question, since it's April Fool's Day. Still though...

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: you turned me down so quickly.
Oh, hehe... erm... sorry about that.

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: It's okay! You don't have to be sorry.

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: Wait, what?

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: Um... well... I... er...
Happy April Fool's Day.

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: I was hoping I'd fool you, but you ended up fooling me.

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: Well, the cat's out of the bag.

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: Happy April Fool's Day.

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: I saw that was a popular April Fool's joke, so I thought I'd give it a try.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: You should have seen Signal's face when she was sending that text. I thought she was gonna have a heart attack.

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: Shut up, Delta!

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: It was obviously a joke, but I still got nervous because I'd never said anything remotely close to that to anyone before.
Well, it was a good prank.

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Signal, I think you succeeded.

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: Woohoo! Good thing we teamed up to make it happen.
So you two cooked this scheme up together?

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: Yep! We thought it'd be a shame not to do anything on April Fool's Day,

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: and Delta said she had a great idea.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: I thought it'd make for a good prank.
Hehehe.

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: I'll send an even better text next year.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Forget text messages.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: We can make your command center our base of operations and come up with something REALLY good.
Wow, that'd certainly be something new.
That might be a bit overkill.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: We'll have to put our heads together to come up with something for next year.

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: All right!
Looking forward to it.
